prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Produce exactly ONE finished title-screen background illustration for the Arena project, landscape 1536x1024. Reference image 1 (TITLE-consulta-3x.png) is the actual decoded TITLE.IMG from The Elder Scrolls Arena 1994 and is authoritative for subject, composition, silhouette and atmosphere, NOT its low resolution or its overlaid text. Reference image 2 (Arena_MQ02_Ria_piloto_v01.png) is ONLY the project's approved finely detailed dark-fantasy digital-painting finish, natural material definition and coherent atmospheric lighting; do NOT copy Ria, magic, ghosts, clouds shaped as people or any subject from image2. Reimagine the source opening faithfully at modern illustration definition: a heavy dark stone medieval fortress/keep with squat square crenellated towers concentrated right of centre, low adjoining ramparts receding toward the left, a smaller rampart/tower at the far right, rocky rising ground beneath the main keep; coarse grasses and weeds silhouetted across the lower foreground. Broad gently luminous blue-violet/lavender twilight sky, pale warm glow along the low left horizon, subdued mossy olive and ochre grass, weathered charcoal-grey stone. Original keeps and walls are the subject; no new palace, city skyline, cathedral, mountains, giant moon, banners, dragons, enemies or invented narrative landmarks. The main fortress should remain recognizably related to the compact battlement silhouette in image1, not a generic sprawling fantasy castle. Dark fantasy, austere, atmospheric, finely articulated masonry and vegetation, painterly detailed high-definition finish consistent with approved project art; not pixel art, not 3D/cartoon, do not recreate dithering or low-resolution blur. Composition: retain the large calm sky across the upper half; quiet clear upper-central region around x25–75%, y18–35% for the game's existing independently rendered Arena title. Keep silhouette readable around x55–80%, y45–67%, with breathing room above and to the right. Existing opaque command panel will occupy central x23–77%, y56–86%, so reserve subdued low-detail tones there and leave recognizable crenellations visible above it. Wider environment at both lateral edges, safe centre crop to approximately4:3 without chopping the main tower. Foreground grass may frame bottom corners but must not obscure the keep. Full-bleed opaque illustration; do NOT paint frame/border, logos, letters, title, menu, captions, copyright text, watermarks or UI. The gold meander frame and typography in reference1 are original screen graphic overlays, not environmental objects: exclude them from the image, game UI remains separate. No people, no observer/protagonist, no hands, silhouettes, faces, statues shaped as people, racial/gender indicators, or voices. One single coherent artwork, no contact sheet, no alternatives.
